title: Income Ratios, Stipulations and Approval Validity — Kestrel Finance Tiers
content:
For Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts, each credit tier sets the income tests a monthly payment must pass, the verifications (stipulations) that must be completed before signing, and the number of calendar days an approval stays open for signing.

## Income tests

| Tier | Maximum payment-to-income (percent of verified gross monthly income) | Maximum debt-to-income, new payment included (percent) | Minimum verified gross monthly income (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Finance Tier E | 12 | 45 | 2000.00 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier D | 14 | 45 | 2000.00 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier C | 15 | 48 | 1800.00 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier B | 16 | 50 | 1800.00 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier A | 18 | 50 | 1500.00 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier A+ | 20 | 50 | 1500.00 |

## Stipulations and approval validity

| Tier | Proof of income (pay stubs or bank statements) | Proof of residence (utility bill or lease matching the application address) | Personal references to verify | Approval validity (calendar days after the decision date) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Finance Tier E | required | required | 4 | 14 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier D | required | required | 2 | 14 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier C | required | not required | 0 | 30 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier B | not required | not required | 0 | 30 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier A | not required | not required | 0 | 30 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier A+ | not required | not required | 0 | 30 |

Approval validity counts the decision date as day 0.

## Tier notes

- Tier E and Tier D approvals carry the full set of verifications: proof of income, proof of residence and personal references (4 at Tier E, 2 at Tier D).
- Tier C carries proof of income only.
- Tier B, Tier A and Tier A+ require none of the three verifications.
- Hypothetical: a verified gross monthly income of 4000.00 at Tier C allows a monthly payment of up to 15 percent of that income, that is 600.00, and total monthly debt including that payment of up to 48 percent, that is 1920.00.
